scenes.summary: The Landbreakers prisoner happens to be Endfield site support technician Copper. He came to this place by tracking distress calls of malfunctioning robots. Most of the robots were heavily damaged and only one seems reparable. You decide to help.

lines.text: Woah... That was a close shave. Those raiders almost got me.

Yearp. Totally fine, thanks to you. Wasn't expecting to get bailed out by a fellow Endfielder out here. The name's Copper. I'm an Endfielder and my job is to perform on-site technical support. The current task is to keep these robots in working shape...
I rushed here when I received repair request signals from them. Solo field work is really dangerous nowadays, but we ... don't really have anyone else to spare... *sigh*...
I never expected the messages to come from an LB camp. That was a very terrifying encounter.
Thankfully, the LBs didn't know that the tripods housed the main systems. The raiders just ripped apart our robots and chucked the tripods to the side.
I treat these robots like my own. I recognize every single unit.
This poor disabled unit is Kevin. Bob is the one with broken legs.
I tried to remotely control them and escape this place, but it alerted the LBs and all of us were captured.
Many of them are damaged beyond repair. I guess we can only save Kevin, but I don't know how long it's going to take...
And there are so many LBs around... Ugh...
Bronzer and I were supposed to conduct this mission as a team. But he felt it was too dangerous and left me behind.
He hadn't gone far when I received the signal sent from this area.
Ugh... If only Bronzer were here. He knows more about repairing robots than me.
Really? You can?! Awesome!

options: Sitch looks pretty bad right now...
I can repair this. Pretty good at it, not gonna lie.

r: Sitch looks pretty bad right now...
I can repair this. Pretty good at it, not gonna lie.

scenes.summary: Copper tells you about broken robots at other places. If you see one, get them repaired and talk to Copper at the Worker Dorms for rewards.

lines.text: Kevin! You're finally well again!
Awesome! Oh, I don't know how to thank you!

These units are just prototypes we jointly developed with the UW. But we were forced to deploy them as things got really desperate. These Deltas feature all-terrain transport capabilities and context-sensitive hostility avoidance.
But if you run into more broken robots, can you please help them out? Valley IV is really dangerous and a non-combatant like me might have to skip field assignments.
And I'm definitely gonna pay you for repairing the robots! Find me at the Worker Dorms for the rewards!

options: Sure. I'll look out for those robots.

r: Sure. I'll look out for those robots.

scenes.summary: The Landbreaker prisoner turns out to be Endfield site support technician Copper, who is also Bronzer's younger twin. He tells you that many robots were heavily damaged while trying to escape from the Landbreakers and only one seems reparable. You decide to help.
